retirement_age.notes: Values are for 2026 (men 61 years 6 months, women 57 years) for workers under normal conditions under the 2019 Labour Code. Statutory is the higher of the two group values. The age rises 3 months per year for men until 62 in 2028 and 4 months per year for women until 60 in 2035.

offices.title: General Secretary of the Communist Party of Vietnam

open_questions: President and Prime Minister were elected by the 16th National Assembly for the 2026-2031 term; the exact end dates were not found, so term_ends is null.
Tô Lâm was first elected General Secretary on 2024-08-03 and re-elected by the 14th Central Committee on 23 January 2026; the end date of the current tenure was not found.
Date of the next National Assembly election not found (last held 2026-03-15).

Population and median age are UN World Population Prospects 2024 values for 2024 taken from a Wikipedia table; the UN projection for 2026 is about 102.2 million and median age 33.9 (populationpyramids.org). A direct UN or national statistics office source was not retrieved.
The retirement ages listed apply to workers under normal conditions; no specific retirement age for senior Party or State offices was found.
